description: The change log of Closed to Machines, a MORVS register of which public institutions serve an automated client that names itself and gives a contact address, what their robots rules say for each path checked, and where the official route to their data is (US federal agency hosts from the Federal Register's agency list, the 50 state legislatures, the G20 members' national government portals and national law sites, and MORVS's own two hosts; checked weekly by two clients, curl and Python urllib, from one residential US vantage, both sending the same identified user agent), from since (a date, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after which entries are returned), with optional host (a host the register covers) and kind (a change kind ID, such as register_created). The log is append-only from the build-day baseline (register_created) and never backfilled: robots-file changes with the home-path verdicts that moved, crawl-delay and Content-Signal changes, home redirect changes, route answer changes, rows added, and a class change once the new class has held three weekly cycles. Returns up to 25 entries, newest leading, or "no change recorded since <date>" with the kinds recorded so far. Nothing here grants permission: a robots rule is a request a site publishes, not a licence, and a page that answered certifies no deeper path. A refusal is the edge's response to this client at a stated time; the vendor named is the responder seen in headers, not the institution's policy, and no record shows a reason. "No answer" (DNS, connection, TLS or timeout) is never a refusal; none_found (reviewed, nothing found where listed) and not_reviewed are kept apart, and neither shows that no route exists. Each answer leads with uncertainty[], then as_of (the cycle date), vantage, the source page on morvs.ai and the licence, and carries the question, vantage, label, robots-not-licence and absence notes (and the self-row note for MORVS's own hosts) and the claim rules. Data more than 9 days old makes each robots verdict and next step unknown, with a note. A failed or malformed read of the register is reported as temporarily unavailable, never as an empty answer. Answers are kept under about 25 KB. Organisations only; officials appear only by office and no person is named.

host.description: Optional host the register covers, for example www.ilga.gov.

kind.description: Optional change kind ID, lower case with underscores, for example register_created.

since.description: Required date (YYYY-MM-DD): entries on or after it, for example 2026-10-30.
